description: This PHP source file defines the NodeSubController class within the Goteo project's admin controllers. It manages administrative actions related to nodes, such as editing node details, managing images, and setting permissions.

classes.name: NodeSubController
classes.description: Controller class handling administrative node-related actions such as editing details and managing permissions in the Goteo platform.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a given user has permission to access the node, disallowing central master nodes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the node, user, and request, setting full node data and context variables.

methods.name: adminsAction
methods.description: Returns the template for the node administrators page.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing node details, including updating text fields and managing images such as logo, label, and home image.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Returns the template for viewing node information.
